items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: I lived with the – what was those boys' names in Norfolk? Shad – there were some brothers that had a band. Shack? Not Collins. I was in California? No, no, in Norfolk, Virginia. That was Shack, that was Garfield Cotter, the Cotter boys.

ctx.x: that, Well, the first number I played on the trumpet when I left Hampton Institute. I knew I was getting lost in the second. I lived with the – what was those boys' names in Norfolk? Shad – there were some brothers that had a band. Shack? Not Collins. I was in California? No, no, in Norfolk, Virginia. That was Shack, that was Garfield Cotter, the Cotter boys. They were quite the good in Virginia, in Norfolk. And Garfield came from New York, you must have known Garfield, because he played with his club club.…
